How our product reviews team tests our products
*If you click on a link in this article, we may earn affiliate revenue.

Kieran Ahuja
 , Reviews Manager
 Published:
 17:05, 6 Oct 2025
 |
 Updated:
 11:21, 28 May 2026
Add us as a preferred source

ONLINE shopping can be a minefield.
We’ve all been burned before; duped by a glossy ad campaign, tempted by a too-good-to-be-true price tag, or won over by a celebrity sponsorship.

So how do you choose between the good and the garbage?
The Sun’s Shopping Reviews section is all about testing what’s trending to help you make an informed decision on whether or not you make a purchase.

regions.text: Our rating system

We keep things simple: every product we test is rated out of ten.
If something gets a ten out of ten from us, it’s one of the best products we’ve encountered in its category.
But there’s a bit more to it than that; in each of our round-ups, be it the best dehumidifiers or the best mattresses, we’ve aimed to split our picks out into some extra categories to help you make an informed decision.

Pros and cons

We give pros and cons to all the products we test so you get the full picture.
Even if we love something, such as in our Tentbox review, we still drill down to find any little flaws you might need to know about.
Sometimes we have a product or two in our round-ups that we can’t find an obvious fault with, but we’ll look hard before we give that assessment.
How do we choose the products we test?

In our Product Reviews section, we aim to be as useful as possible.
That means we put a lot of effort into finding the products that people want to know about, whether it’s trending on TikTok or something people are searching for on Google.
Naturally, when the weather gets hot, we’ll start testing out things to help keep you cool, whether that’s the best cooling mattresses or a hi-tec Dyson fan.

Specialist expertise

We have a team of in-house specialists who are fully immersed in their individual areas of expertise.
They attend events and showcases to explore new products and personally test out hundreds of products a year.
When commissioning our reviews, The Sun will hand-pick the writer(s) with the most experience in that area, so they are not only able to share insights on the specific product they’re test

Meet the Shopping Team
How long do we spend testing products?

Thoroughly testing out products is at the core of what we do in our Product Reviews section.
But, because we try out such a wide range of products, there isn’t a one-size-fits-all approach to testing.
For each item, we test out if its features work as they should, if it’s of good quality and if it represents value for money.

We’ve outlined some specific examples below:

regions.text: How we test mattresses

It’s fair to say that mattresses are having a moment.
There’s been an explosion in the number of online mattress sellers over the last few years, all of which claim to be the ‘best reviewed’ or the ‘most awarded’.

Because buying a mattress is one of the more expensive purchases you’re likely to make for your home, we’ve put a lot of time into testing out the latest models for sale.
We do this by giving the mattresses to our writers and testers for a period of months before they reach a verdict; it can take time to work out whether a mattress is performing as it should, so we tend to take things slow.

How we test kitchen appliances

We’re big fans of kitchen appliances, whether it’s an essential like one of the best air fryers or a party piece like the Ninja Slushi.
We usually hand out kitchen appliances to keen home cooks who’ll put the gadgets through their paces.
Similarly to mattresses, we like our testers to have the gadgets for as long as possible, allowing them to properly kick the tyres before giving their verdict.

regions.text: How we test fitness apparel and equipment

There are few things more prone to big claims than fitness equipment.
There is no end of products that promise to help you lose weight, improve your performance, or get you focused.
That’s why, when we test things, we hand over the gadgets to sports fanatics and personal trainers to really put fitness gear through its paces.

How we test cosmetics

We love getting our hands on the latest beauty products and with so many launches happening, we’re constantly testing the latest skincare, makeup and hair care.
We aim to test cosmetics on a variety of individuals with different skin types and hair types, including beauty experts and professionals, to get a balanced perspective on the efficacy of a particular product.

How we update our content

Over time we try and update all the reviews and round-ups we write.
We do this for a couple of reasons: for starters, we like our articles to reflect the latest prices and deals.
We also update our round-ups to reflect new products that we hadn’t tested when we wrote the original piece to help you get the full picture.
Finally, we’ll sometimes add lookback segments in our reviews to see how an ite
Why you can trust us

When you read one of our reviews, you can be sure you’re getting our honest opinion on the product.
We will test the products as a user would, in real-life, with a minimum number of testing days required.
If we continue to use the product after the review is written and our opinion changes on anything, we will update the review to reflect this.

Affiliate disclosure

Some of the links in our articles are affiliate links. That means that if you click on a link in an article, we might make a commission.
It costs the reader no extra on their purchase, but the revenue earned from the sale or click helps us to continue investing in testing out products.
Your privacy

We use your information to provide you with the products and services you request, as well as to understand how and why our audiences engage with us.
This allows us to personalise content, show you relevant adverts that supports our journalism and content, and generally improve your experience of our products and services.
